pay_salary_schedule_001.evidence: Effective July 1, 2013, the 2012-2013 Teachers’ Salary Schedule will be substituted and replaced with a new 2013-2014 Salary Schedule as set forth in Appendix A of this Agreement.

pay_salary_schedule_002.evidence: replaced with a new 2013-2014 Salary Schedule as set forth in Appendix A of this Agreement.

pay_step_increment_003.evidence: employees on a step salary schedule will be eligible for a step increment at the beginning of the school year; however, the step increment will not be implemented until the value of the step has been determined through negotiations.

pay_prior_experience_005.evidence: previous public and/or private satisfactory teaching experience, including satisfactory teaching experience at the District Charter School, will be recognized for placement on the Teachers’ Salary Schedule upon returning from leave if his/her Charter School Leave had a duration of at least one school year.

pay_performance_pay_006.evidence: employees represented by the Association who are full-time or half-time employees of the District on the date this Agreement is adopted by the School Board who were evaluated as either “Effective” or “Highly Effective” on their 2012-2013 annual evaluations will receive a Performance Pay increase

pay_performance_pay_007.answer: Teachers must be evaluated as “Effective” or “Highly Effective” on their annual evaluations.
pay_performance_pay_007.evidence: evaluated as either “Effective” or “Highly Effective” on their 2012-2013 annual evaluations will receive a Performance Pay increase
